params.body: The VM on v0.22.0: the release in which a word may name one act and is spent on use (control#63). Nothing changes for a hand whose grant lists no kind under `per_action`; Vera's review hand lists `review.invite` and `review.sign` since elixir#202, and its client asks for the right word since vera#12.
params.title: De VM op v0.22.0
